issue.title: mockito 2.0.14 fails to mock jetty httpclient
issue.body:
this fails: 
     import org.eclipse.jetty.client.HttpClient;
    HttpClient httpClient = mock(HttpClient.class);
(jetty 9.2.10.v20150310) with mockito 2.0.2-beta i can mock that class without a problem. stacktrace: 
java.lang.IllegalAccessError: tried to access class org.eclipse.jetty.util.component.ContainerLifeCycle$Managed from class org.eclipse.jetty.client.HttpClient$MockitoMock$362486671

final: {"number": 233, "label": "bug", "route": "repro-check", "related": [216, 323], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/creation/bytebuddy/ByteBuddyMockMaker.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/creation/bytebuddy/SubclassBytecodeGenerator.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/creation/instance/ObjenesisInstantiator.java"], "reply": "Thanks for the detailed report. It has the Mockito version (2.0.14, with 2.0.2-beta working), a short snippet calling mock(HttpClient.class), the expected and actual behaviour, and the full stack trace, so it is reproducible as written with Jetty 9.2.10 on the classpath. The failing path is the mock class generation in SubclassBytecodeGenerator.mockClass, which ByteBuddyMockMaker.createMock delegates to. The IllegalAccessError is raised while the generated mock class initialises, so the class to look at is SubclassBytecodeGenerator."}
